notification: HOW LONG CAN YOU AVOID THE INEVITABLE?
Are you waiting for a sign?
Your heart beats its last countdown.
Your pulse quickens to its end.

main.text: Life is not a problem to be solved, but a reality to be experienced.
main.author: Søren Kierkegaard

main.text: Man is the only creature who refuses to be what he is.
main.author: Albert Camus

main.text: The unexamined life is not worth living.
main.author: Socrates

main.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
main.author: Seneca

main.text: Life is what happens when you're busy making other plans.
main.author: John Lennon

main.text: The purpose of life is not to be happy. It is to be useful.
main.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

main.text: In the book of life, the answers aren't in the back.
main.author: Charles M. Schulz
